PayrollPro HR Suite - User Manual & Visual Guide

Welcome to the complete non-technical user manual for PayrollPro HR Suite. This guide explains every menu, button, and option in simple, everyday language so HR managers, business owners, and non-technical staff can manage payroll, attendance, and compliance effortlessly.

MENU 01

Executive Action Dashboard

💡
What is this screen for?
The Action Dashboard is your main command center. When you log in, this screen shows your entire company's live health status, including headcount, attendance, pending leave applications, and urgent tasks.
1
2
3
4

Component-by-Component Explanation:

PIN 1

Top Executive Metric Cards

Four summary boxes showing total active employees, month-to-date attendance rate, pending leave count, and estimated monthly salary payout.

🎯 Non-Tech Benefit: Know your exact monthly salary bill without running reports.
PIN 2

Urgent HR Action Queue

Lists time-sensitive tasks that need your response, such as pending attendance regularization or upcoming compliance deadlines.

🎯 Non-Tech Benefit: Prevents missing important HR deadlines.
PIN 3

Fast-Approve Pending Leave Inbox

Displays incoming employee leave applications with instant "Approve" and "Reject" buttons right on your home screen.

🎯 Non-Tech Benefit: Approve employee leave requests in 1 click without opening multiple pages.
PIN 4

Attendance Overview & Quick Actions

Shows a visual pie chart breakdown of today's attendance (Present vs. Absent vs. On Leave) along with quick action shortcuts.

🎯 Non-Tech Benefit: Instant visual headcount check every morning.
MENU 02

Employee Directory & Master Records

💡
What is this screen for?
This is your central employee database. You can search staff by name or ID, filter by department, add new employees, or click any employee card to view their full master profile.
1
2
3
PIN 1

Smart Search & Department Filter

Search box and department dropdown to quickly locate any employee in your organization.

🎯 Non-Tech Benefit: Find staff records instantly.
PIN 2

Add New Employee Wizard

Green button opening a step-by-step form to onboard new hires with auto-generated Employee IDs.

🎯 Non-Tech Benefit: Add new joiners in 2 minutes.
PIN 3

Employee Master Cards

Visual cards displaying photo, full name, designation, department, branch, joining date, and status.

🎯 Non-Tech Benefit: Click any card to open their complete file.
MENU 02b

Employee 1-Page Master Profile

💡
What is this screen for?
Displays everything about an individual employee on one clean page: Salary Breakdown, Bank Deposit Account, PAN/Aadhaar/UAN numbers, and employment details.
1
2
3
PIN 1

Monthly Earnings Breakdown

Itemized table showing Basic Salary, HRA, Special Allowance, and gross monthly pay.

PIN 2

Statutory Deductions & Net Pay

Calculates PF 12%, Professional Tax, Income Tax TDS, and final Net Deposit Salary.

PIN 3

Edit Salary Components Button

Allows HR to customize individual rupee amounts for specific salary components.

MENU 03

31-Day Attendance Grid & Biometric Sync

💡
What is this screen for?
An Excel-like grid that lets you view and edit daily attendance for all 31 days of the month on one screen. You can also import biometric clock-in logs automatically.
1
2
PIN 1

Weekly-Off Rule Applicator

Dropdown to apply "Sunday (Standard)" or "Saturday & Sunday (5-Day)" weekly-off rules across the entire month in 1 click.

PIN 2

31-Day Grid Roster

Colour-coded cells showing Present (P), Absent (A), Weekly Off (WO), or Leave (L) for every employee.

MENU 04

Leave & Holidays Management

💡
What is this screen for?
Manage employee leave applications, view remaining leave balances, track official company holidays, and configure weekend sandwich rules.
MENU 05

7-Step Guided Indian Payroll Engine

💡
What is this screen for?
A step-by-step wizard that walks non-technical HR users through processing monthly salaries. It automatically handles attendance locking, overtime, advance recovery, PF/ESIC/PT/TDS deductions, and bank payout files.
1
2
PIN 1

7-Step Visual Payroll Stepper

Shows your exact progress from Attendance Lock to Bank Disbursal.

PIN 2

Proceed to Next Step Button

Calculates taxes and statutory deductions automatically as you move forward.

MENU 06

Statutory Compliance Hub (IN)

💡
What is this screen for?
Generates official statutory filing files required by the Indian government, including EPFO PF ECR text files, ESIC monthly return summaries, and Form 24Q TDS files.
MENU 07

Statutory Registers (Form IV B, ECR, Form XVI)

💡
What is this screen for?
Renders official Indian statutory registers required during government inspection, complete with your company logo watermark on print/PDF outputs.
MENU 08

HR Letters & Service Certificates Generator

💡
What is this screen for?
Generate official HR letters (Offer, Appointment, Relieving Certificate, Increment, Warning) instantly. Select an employee to merge data, edit paragraphs live, and print with your official company watermark.
1
2
3
PIN 1

Template & Employee Dropdowns

Choose letter type and employee to auto-fill names, salaries, and dates.

PIN 2

Editable Content Editor

Type or modify letter body text live with dynamic variable tag buttons.

PIN 3

A4 Letterhead Live Preview & PDF Print

Shows exact printable letterhead with company logo watermark and signature seal block.

MENU 09

Reports & Payroll Analytics

💡
What is this screen for?
Download itemized Pay Register spreadsheets (.CSV), view ESI/PT tax summaries, and track headcount growth charts.
MENU 10

Masters & Company Profile Setup

💡
What is this screen for?
Configure company rules: attendance grace periods, overtime multipliers, company profile details, corporate logo upload, and salary component masters.
1
2
PIN 1

Policy Setup Engine

Configure attendance rules, grace periods, LOP basis, and overtime multipliers.

PIN 2

Company Profile & Logo Watermark Upload

Upload official company logo used as a background watermark across PDF documents.

MENU 11

Workflow-First Journey Map

💡
What is this screen for?
A visual roadmap showing how employee records progress naturally from hiring to monthly payroll and exit management.
MENU 12

Integrations & Connected APIs

💡
What is this screen for?
Shows connected hardware and cloud services, including biometric thumb machines, Razorpay bank payout gateways, and the EPFO employer portal.
